name: expo-content-transition
tagline: Native content transitions for React Native + Expo
description: expo-content-transition brings native content transitions to React Native and Expo apps. The Swift-based library closes the animation gap that has long existed between the smooth native transitions on iOS and what RN/Expo developers could reach for. 163 stars in four days suggests it fills a real, felt gap in the Expo ecosystem.
highlights: Native content transitions for React Native and Expo
Closes a long-standing gap in RN/Expo animation tooling
curatorNote: Expo devs have watched native iOS transitions with envy for years. A library that hands them the same primitives is an instant ecosystem win.
